notes.title: New Game In Alpha
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I haven't abandoned you—I’ve just been busy working on my current game, which you can check out further down below.

In this post, I wanted to show off some of the new things I've been working on and explain what happened to all the posts about the last game (Untitled). I’ve been developing a new game called Rule and Ruin, an auto-battler/minimalistic city builder. It’s been in development for around two months now. So far, it has been released in alpha and has received tons of constructive criticism, which has been extremely helpful for development. I’ve really been enjoying working with people and reading comments on my YouTube channel about what they’d like to see in the game. This kind of involvement and having a small community is all I’ve ever wanted when it comes to making games. It has genuinely been a pleasure.

Now, onto the next thing. The last game has been "scrapped" for now. I may return to it in the future, but I wanted to try something different with this new game. I've never worked on an RTS-style game before, so I wanted to give it a shot. Since I’m still relatively new to game development, experimenting with different genres and ideas is a great way to grow on this journey. As much as I loved working on KoChaos, it was a nightmare. It was meant to be my dream game—a mashup of so many ideas—but I kept constantly revising and changing the core gameplay, which isn’t ideal for a released product.

With Rule and Ruin, I want to be as transparent as possible and stick to my goals as a developer. Creating a small, engaged community and making games people enjoy are both dreams of mine. I just want to keep practicing and improving.

Now that all of that is out of the way, the alpha version of the game is available on itch.io for anyone to check out! It’s constantly being updated. I didn’t include too much detail about the game here because I wanted to establish as much as possible before posting it. Below, you’ll find some screenshots, a description, and a link to the game.

Rule and Ruin (Alpha)

Introduction
After the fall of civilization, the world lies broken and lawless. From the wreckage, factions rise, seeking to shape the future with blood and stone. Pledge your loyalty, build a mighty city amid the chaos, and stand ready to defend it against all who would tear it down. In this new age, only the relentless will endure.

Gameplay
In Rule and Ruin, your mission is to build and expand a mighty city while assembling an unstoppable army. Battles unfold automatically, but your strength lies in preparation — grow your forces, fortify your city, and withstand the relentless enemy factions that seek to tear everything you’ve built into ruin.

The Game's Future

At the moment, Rule and Ruin is in alpha. There will be countless updates before the game is ready for a Steam release. The update schedule will bring one major version each month. Right now, I’m working on new content every day, so if you’re interested in devlogs and other updates, you can check out my YouTube channel below.

There’s also a credits section in the game to recognize people who have suggested features or offered tips for improvements. If you’d like a chance to have your name featured there, you can leave suggestions here or in the comments on my channel.

I hope you’re as excited for the future of the game as I am.

notes.title: Performance Issues!
notes.content:
So sorry! If you are having performance issues with the game, it is a very easy fix! Game Maker Studio 2 is what I use to program and distribute this game and the future game I am working on. 

If you are having upscaling and performance issues you will need to install the latest .NET Framework from here,

https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet-framework

So sorry I did not address this issue sooner. If you have installed another game that has install .NET you most likely are having some other issue. Most performance problems seem to stem from tis however.

Have an awesome day!

- Alex :)

notes.title: KoChaos Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hey all! This is an announcement about steam deck compatibility! So with the last few updates I’ve worked hard on ensuring that the game works flawlessly with the steam deck and no crashes or major bugs occur. I’m happy to let you know what is supported with the deck.

- Does KoChaos work with proton?
Yes the game works and has no issues. I’ve used the experimental and latest versions. No issues.

- Does KoChaos work with the control layout on the steam deck?
From all I’ve tested, keyboard and the native controller inputs have worked flawlessly and I personally have not occurred any issues. Others have also tested with their deck and have had no issues, though your experience could vary depending on the type of inputs you use. I’ve used a PS4, PS5, and XBOX controller and they all work just fine. There are also prompts within the game as well to let you know what you must press for a character to perform that action.

- How well does KoChaos perform on the deck?
The game performs amazingly. No stuttering and the game gets a consistent sixty frames per second. With the game being 2D it should not come to anyone’s surprise it would perform great.

- How well is text readability in KoChaos on the deck?
All text large and small is more than readable. The only text I would expect anyone not to read is the enemy health points. Other than that I would say that’s cleared.

With the game also receiving its latest update I would say it makes the game more than playable with tons of content to experience and more to come.

With all that being said, I’d say you can enjoy the game on the go with your deck with no issues.

Have a great day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.content:
Hey all! So this is an everyday update. It's sizable so I didn't want to include it in the small patches section.

So let's get down to it.

Once again, I've changed many things with the end game. I've made it to where the void has more enemy variety and functions as one. I've also added more enemy variety to the Dune and Fire areas as well. 

I've also decreased the amount of gold needed to upgrade healing by half.

I've added more ways of getting gold and decreased its rarity from enemies.
Gold now drops from bosses. The amount might be changed in the future though.

That's it besides a few little tweaks here and there.

Let me know what you think.

Have an amazing day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.2
notes.content:
Hey all! Really large update here. We are adding new enemies to end-game content and UI changes.

So with this update, I will say this one gave me some trouble and will also be reworked. They are mainly just end-game enemies. Not all bosses have their enemy types so this will be fixed in the future.

I have added new UI elements to further show you the moveset of the heroes. I saw a lot of people playing the game not knowing you can jump or dash. So here that is. 

I have also reworked healing. You can upgrade it now. So each hero does not have a healing stat. This is for simplicity's sake so trying to level a new hero is not such a drag.

Xp rates have also been adjusted so grinding is not a terrible drag anymore. Each difficulty has had its cap expanded way more!

There were way more changes but for now, this is all. 

I hope you have a great day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content: Hey all! So with this small patch, I have just fixed a bug and reworked ascension slightly. Each ascension button now shows the hero's ascension level. I also fixed a bug with the restart button when pausing. I also removed some portraits that were not supposed to be there—easy small QOL fixes.

notes.title: KoChaos 2.0
notes.content:
Hey all! So with this new update, I am going to let you know that a mechanic was removed in place of a new one. So just letting you know right off the bat.

So let's go over this update. 

- New Mechanic -
So with the new mechanic, it replaces the enlisters and you can now ascend your hero. This took over the enlisters because they were too much of a hassle behind the scenes. Something similar will return in the future but for now, this will work way better and bring back the "Infinite Leveling". So this can also ensure that it is completely optional.

- End Game Content -
So. Difficulty has been spiked up, but this is to rival the whole ascension mechanic. I have added tons of new bosses. Once you have completed the base game and defeated the Overseer, you may enter the void and fight the brand-new bosses in the all-new Boss Rush. They all have been tuned to be extremely difficult and to challenge you. 

The first two bosses have their themed arena. The last few are a part of the void so they will not. 

In future updates, I will add more bosses. 

- No New Heroes -
So you might see that the version has hit 2.0. You're probably a little disappointed that there are no new heroes. Sadly I did not have any time to work on any due to the sheer amount of bosses added in this update. Trust me there will be more to come. I just wanted to push this update out so I can finalize the game.

- Final Thoughts -
So I have just said that the game is finalized. Yes. This will be the new gameplay loop. Fight and gain levels. The more you fight and play the stronger you will get. And you will also have ascending to do as well. So with everything added in this update, I can finally say the game is "Complete". There will be more to come but this is just me saying that the game is finalized and completely playable.

- Bugs and More -
If you experience any bugs whatsoever, please do not be afraid to comment here and let me know of them. 

With all that out of the way, update the game hop in, and slay away!

Have a great day!

-Alex:)

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Hey all! It's a pretty sizable update here. I've changed quite a bit so make sure to reset progress! This update will break your saves. So with this update, I've brought back music. I have also added the new boss event. This is a new way to grind XP and max your hero out. Level caps have been brought back. You can also now unlock Enlisters. They're the latest change to the game. They're something to look forward to unlocking as they can help quickly level your heroes. Or optionally you don't ever have to use them. They're there to make grinding less tedious for you.

So with this new update, I hope you like it. Now and then the boss for the events will change and there will be more to come in the future. This also means I will be skipping making new factions and changing the map as we currently know it. It will be larger and more roaming will be happening. 

Again I hope you like and until next time. 

- Alex :)

notes.title: Small Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hey all! With the new update released, I want to discuss what is planned for the future content of the game!

So with the new update rolled out, I finally have some steps to take with the game. You now have an incentive to play! Besides that, I want to discuss what I want to add, or basically, a roadmap.

1. I want to finish up on some ideas for future enemy types. I want to add 2 more maps with different enemy types and they all affect something different. Right now I am still planning this.

2. I want to add a shop where you can earn some cool skins for characters. I even want to add some cool stuff for when you reach a high level. Not sure yet though.

3. Steam achievements... I had someone ask me about these. I am not so sure if I will be adding these yet or not. I want to make them an in-game achievement tracker more than using Steam for this. This will make porting in the future a lot easier.

4. Yes. I said porting. I am not sure as this is a maybe, but I would love to make a Free To Play mobile version along with future console ports if I could raise the money. Right now I am still wanting to finish the game here first.

5. More heroes. There will be more, but for right now I want to finish everything first before I make more. Maybe a secret hero at some point.

This is the small road map. I am starting to work on the enemy types and new bosses so I will show more in the next devlog. 

For now, have an amazing day!

- Alex :)

notes.title: Small Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hey all! This is going to be straight to the point.

So within the last few weeks as I said in the previous log I had been very busy with the update. This update converts the entire game to something new. It's extremely awesome.

Now this will be the biggest update so far. But with that being the case, I will say it will seem as if the content is lackluster. This will be the 1.0 update. This will be the game in its final form and the step towards much more content planned in the future. 

- The Current Content -
So far there are 8 heroes and 5 bosses. If you've played the "Demo" you'll know there are currently 4, but the other is a secret boss. This will be a theme that will play out fairly normally with each new update onwards. Small little secrets and other stuff like that. 

I am currently play-testing the new update but I am safe to say that the new update is very very close to release. I want to make sure this update does not break. This is due to the new save system being implemented. The save system is not very complicated and I will talk about what exactly it saves.

So with the new update here soon I will release a gameplay trailer and update the Steam page. The game's pricing will remain the same as it was. Free. No need for pricing lol.

Anyways the new save system saves XP for your profile and all 8 heroes. Whenever you level up your hero will gain some stats permanently. This means that every time you come back to play, you will always be on the same level. So far there are no plans to make a max level, I like the idea that someone would want to grind and get to come back to see their progression and high-level characters.

Now I am still kind of improvising on the new system as I wanted to make each character have a level for each stat. This would add tons of incentive for anyone to want to grind something specific. 

Anyway for now I am going to leave the progression there. 

So far all heroes are complete. I am still working out the kinks on some of them. So far my favorite change to the hero Barnel is his dash attack. Whenever he leaps he can now infinitely shoot. It's pretty awesome. 

That's all for this devlog. I just wanted to address and elaborate on some stuff said in the last one.

Have an awesome day!

- Alex:)

notes.title: Small Devlog #2
notes.content:
So within the last few weeks, I've given myself to work on the new update a lot! Tons and tons of new changes are making their way to KoChaos! Let's get into them. 

Hey all! I know it's been a while. I have been at work on the new update like crazy. I have been adding new heroes, new ways to progress, and finishing off the final boss. I want to show some of the stuff off here.

- New Heroes -

Alane
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/d855d1c560693ac6ef662ae43e928dd90ea3979f.gif[/img]
Madame Rouge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/1e63ab03c93e262d51ccd5ffc7c4402d8279baeb.gif[/img]
Henna
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/72dec20ee6c1b1e8e436666c725d49c812219b78.gif[/img]
Bam Bam
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/8aced4c61ef3475e7f1baea2bf04d23b4f8e24f7.gif[/img]

All the heroes shown here so far are brand new and are all fully playable as of now. There is one more hero that is still in the works. Right now I am working on the concept. I will not be showing this one off because it is the final unlockable character.

Gameplay trailers for each hero will be coming soon in the future. I am not sure exactly when but eventually.

- Progression -

So along with new heroes and other stuff comes progression. Progression is done weirdly but I like the way it works. 

So to unlock new characters you will have a profile level. You will need to level up your profile to a specific level to unlock a certain character. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/86e916c54d5b530b917d09d0ada328801e0ae6e7.png[/img]
After you've gotten to the next level to unlock a certain character, that character will also have a level. 
Once you level up that character, you will unlock and amass an army of apprentices and field fighters. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/7514fa6fe2c670c297cedadcc31eee43a06a731d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/19b248af3faac689b0f87d4a0c6c8c25e6b1cb41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/553107f07b6146a166a826e62865cc3d5fd4e569.png[/img]
Starting the game will be fairly difficult but this is by design as the longer you play the game gets easier. Whenever you beat a round you gain XP, and if you level your profile you will gain global stats that are for every character. These are modifiers that increase attack, hp, and attack speed. As of right now, there are only three but I plan to add more. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/7f3ce3d643bc7d966c74e3ac6433d112ec86cef4.png[/img]
For now, this is all I wanted to show off. I plan to show off way more stuff. I would like to say the game is very very close to completion. I have one more hero to work on and some juice to add to the game. It's coming along very nicely. Soon I will release a beta branch for the game for certain people to test. If you would like to help test and leave feedback in the future keep an eye out and you can do so as well.

Have an amazing day!

-Alex:)

notes.title: Small Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey all! I've got some cool stuff to show off today. In this little post, I want to share some stuff coming to the game in the official release and talk about changes regarding the game store page and price change. 

I first want to show this screenshot of the catalog page. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/814f2a82c27c1de133cec862acad422b278267ce.png[/img]

You will gain two types of experience at the end of a round. You will use this to keep track of your most used hero and how much you have played as well. You can also see there are unlockables now. To use minis, you will have to level up your hero. 

Leveling has not been balanced, but getting the next hero will not take an immense amount of time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/3f03b40a7a4c1cce3eb2a3513a79ccc60b993c78.png[/img]

After you level your hero there will be more types of things to collect and unlock in the future, but again this is just some early stuff.
 
Here below is an early concept for a new hero I am currently working on. 

Elemental Wizard, Klor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795397/1a64c1263b9c379354292fb2f1982bda7abe72c7.gif[/img]

This character has not been fully fleshed out and has not seen any game time yet, but I am currently working on his design as we speak. I plan for him to have three different types of elements to use as a projectile. 

Now that I've shown that I want to say that with all of these changes, there is too much for me to complete at once, so I wanted to announce that the game will launch and officially have seasons. 

This idea has not been fully fleshed out but with each (major) update there will be a new season, meaning a new map, with new enemy types and a new hero. This is how the 1.0 update will be. The seasons will always be accessible. It's more or less a way for me to label updates. Plus it just sounds cooler. 

With season one, I am wanting to release this as the official 1.0 update. This will be considered a full release. The plan is to have at least two new heroes and the emerald faction finished. So far the emerald faction is technically "finished" but is still needing some tweaks programming-wise.

I am also going to be working on a completely new map for the emerald faction. They are on a type of map that I would like to say does not match their theme at all. This will come way later after I've added more characters and finished everything else.

Here is some completed artwork.

So now that I've shown some early stuff I quickly wanted to discuss the store page. It is currently unfinished and has been since release. I will be fixing this before release and adding a new trailer and updated screenshots. This is just something that I am not willing to fix at the moment. 

Coming with new changes will be a price change at release. I will be changing the price on release. There has not been a decided price and it will not be much but I felt as if I should say it here. 

Besides that, I hope you all have an amazing day and are staying hydrated. 

- Alex :)

notes.title: Taking a break.
notes.content:
Hey all! This is going to be some awesome but disappointing news. Here recently I've been releasing updates nonstop. Not because I have to, but because I wanted to. I tried to finalize the game some and let you have a taste of what is to come in the future. 

Now that I have finally found some footing with the game, I am going to be taking a break from releasing content for a good while. This doesn't mean I will not ever release again, but quite the opposite! 

Right now I am currently working on a new system to implement progression and new ways to fend off enemies as I speak. I just want to take time and work on the game till completion and from there on out, add new heroes and bosses and areas and whatnot. 

I am not going to lie, as this will take time, but I work on this game with every bit of free time I have. Not because I have to but because I want to. There will be news posts, however. I will be posting updates on how the current update is going. 

Once the big update rolls out, the game will be out of "BETA" and will finally reset to just 1.0.

So for now this will be the last update for a good while. I hope you have an amazing day!

- Alex :)
